QuestInfo.name: [Epic Dungeon] High Mountain
QuestInfo.0:
Selazar, a mysterious bard, appeared in Cernium. He considered himself a wandering genius of Grandis, a god of ballads, and a bard singing the truth of the world...

This man looked very suspicious, but wanted you to hear what he has to say.
